margin_stop.description: A Characteristic is settled when its score margin (95% interval half-width) is at or below this value.

uncertainty_giveup.description: A Characteristic is given up when its uncertainty (skipped entries divided by all entries) is at or above this value.

giveup_min_asked.description: Minimum number of entries (answered or skipped) a Characteristic needs before it can be given up.

min_answered.description: Minimum non-null entries for the margin to use the observed spread, and for a Characteristic to count as measured.

stability_window.description: Number of recent running means compared with the current score to judge score stability.

stability_delta.description: Largest distance from the current score that each running mean in the stability window may have.

balancing_min_score.description: Absolute score above which a balancing Question is required before a Characteristic can be settled.

evidence_sd.description: Assumed standard deviation of one evidence entry, used for the margin while fewer than min_answered entries exist.

profile_measured_ratio.description: Share of a Profile's Characteristics that must have at least min_answered non-null entries for the Profile to be well explored.

profile_settled_ratio.description: Share of a Profile's Characteristics that must be settled or given up for the Profile to be well explored.

profile_margin_stop.description: Largest Profile margin (95% interval half-width of the Profile score) allowed for the Profile to be well explored.

quality_min_characteristics.description: Number of measured Characteristics (at least min_answered non-null entries) needed before the response-quality check can raise a flag.

quality_margin_max.description: Response-quality flag is raised when the mean margin of the measured Characteristics is above this value (answers too scattered to measure anything).

quality_keying_max.description: Response-quality flag is raised when the mean gap between the direction-adjusted answers to positively and negatively weighted Questions of the same Characteristic is above this value (answers do not follow the wording).

quality_spread_min.description: Response-quality flag is raised when the standard deviation of the Characteristic scores is below this value and quality_flat_max_mean applies (answers are flat and near the middle, so the scores do not tell Characteristics apart).

quality_flat_max_mean.description: The flat-scores check applies only when the absolute mean of the Characteristic scores is at or below this value, so respondents who truly rate everything high or low are not flagged.
